title: SC chat by MEMObjk_1236
script:
--// SC CHAT | by MEMObjk_1236
--// SADECE GUI CHAT
--// Normal Roblox chatine MESAJ GÖNDERMEZ

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local ADMIN_NAME = "MEMObjk_1236"

--==================================================
-- GUI
--==================================================

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SC_Chat"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ANA PENCERE
local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Name = "Main"
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 430, 0, 315)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -215, 0.5, -157)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18)
main.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Parent = gui

local mainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
mainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(75, 75, 85)
mainStroke.Thickness = 1.5
mainStroke.Parent = main

--==================================================
-- BAŞLIK
--==================================================

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 45)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "SC chat | by MEMObjk_1236"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.TextSize = 19
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = main

--==================================================
-- KAPATMA X
--==================================================

local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -45, 0, 3)
close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
close.Text = "X"
close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
close.TextSize = 20
close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
close.Parent = main

--==================================================
-- BİLGİ
--==================================================

local info = Instance.new("TextLabel")
info.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 25)
info.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 43)
info.BackgroundTransparency = 1
info.Text = "👊 SC CHAT • SADECE BU GUI"
info.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 180)
info.TextSize = 12
info.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
info.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
info.Parent = main

--==================================================
-- MESAJ ALANI
--==================================================

local messages = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
messages.Name = "Messages"
messages.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, -125)
messages.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 72)
messages.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 9, 11)
messages.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
messages.BorderSizePixel = 0
messages.ScrollBarThickness = 5
messages.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
messages.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
messages.Parent = main

local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 7)
padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 7)
padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
padding.Parent = messages

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Parent = messages

--==================================================
-- MESAJ YAZMA
--==================================================

local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 40)
box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 1, -50)
box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
box.BorderSizePixel = 0
box.PlaceholderText = "Mesaj yaz..."
box.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 140)
box.Text = ""
box.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
box.TextSize = 14
box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
box.Parent = main

local boxStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
boxStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
boxStroke.Thickness = 1
boxStroke.Parent = box

--==================================================
-- GÖNDER
--==================================================

local send = Instance.new("TextButton")
send.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 40)
send.Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, -50)
send.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 52)
send.BorderSizePixel = 0
send.Text = "Gönder"
send.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
send.TextSize = 13
send.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
send.Parent = main

--==================================================
-- SC🎃 AÇMA BUTONU
--==================================================

local openButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
openButton.Name = "SC_Open"
openButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 40)
openButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
openButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
openButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
openButton.Text = "SC🎃"
openButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
openButton.TextSize = 16
openButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
openButton.Visible = false
openButton.Parent = gui

local openStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
openStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(75, 75, 85)
openStroke.Thickness = 1.5
openStroke.Parent = openButton

--==================================================
-- MESAJ EKLE
--==================================================

local function addMessage(username, message, isAdmin)

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 0)
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

	label.TextSize = 14
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham

	if isAdmin then
		label.Text = "[ADMİN] " .. username .. ": " .. message
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60)
	else
		label.Text = username .. ": " .. message
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)
	end

	label.Parent = messages

	task.defer(function()
		messages.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(
			0,
			messages.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y
		)
	end)
end

--==================================================
-- AÇILIŞ MESAJI
--==================================================

addMessage(
	ADMIN_NAME,
	"aynı serverde açılmazsa gözükmeyecektir⚠️",
	true
)

--==================================================
-- SADECE GUI'YE MESAJ GÖNDER
--==================================================

local function sendMessage()

	local text = box.Text

	if not text then
		return
	end

	if text:gsub("%s+", "") == "" then
		return
	end

	-- 200 karakter sınırı
	if #text > 200 then
		text = string.sub(text, 1, 200)
	end

	-- NORMAL ROBLOX CHATİNE GÖNDERİLMEZ
	addMessage(
		player.Name,
		text,
		player.Name == ADMIN_NAME
	)

	box.Text = ""
end

send.MouseButton1Click:Connect(sendMessage)

box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)

	if enterPressed then
		sendMessage()
	end

end)

--==================================================
-- KAPAT / AÇ
--==================================================

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	main.Visible = false
	openButton.Visible = true

end)

openButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	main.Visible = true
	openButton.Visible = false

end)

--==================================================
-- SÜRÜKLEME
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = main.Position

	end

end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		main.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)

	end

end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = false

	end

end)

print("SC Chat GUI aktif | Normal Roblox chatine göndermez.")
